bio: Looking out to Lake Wakatipu and the surrounding mountains, the restaurant exudes a warm, relaxing atmosphere. Oak flooring, leather chairs and fur throws resonate with the clothing brand's timeless, refined style. Modern New Zealand fare is the mainstay of the menu and most ingredients – as well as the wines – are locally sourced. The market fish of the day and handmade pastas are standouts. In summer, get closer to nature by dining al fresco on the lawn.
